questions.thirdPartySharing: Shin kuna raba bayanan masu amfani da wasu kamfanoni?

explanations.collectsData: Dokar NDP ta shafi duk wani sarrafa bayanan sirri na 'yan Najeriya.
explanations.sensitiveData: Sashe na 30 yana buƙatar kariya ta musamman ga bayanan sirri masu mahimmanci ciki har da bayanan lafiya da bayometrik.
explanations.hasPrivacyPolicy: Sashe na 27 yana buƙatar manufar sirri mai gaskiya da sauƙin isa.
explanations.crossBorderTransfer: Sassan 41-43 suna hana canja wurin bayanai zuwa ƙasashen da basu da isasshen matakan kariya.
explanations.hasConsentMechanism: Sashe na 26 yana buƙatar izini na musamman, bayyananne, da kuma maras shakka.
explanations.targetsChildren: Sashe na 31 yana buƙatar tabbatar da shekaru da izinin iyaye ga masu amfani da basu kai shekara 18 ba.
explanations.thirdPartySharing: Sashe na 25 yana buƙatar yarjejeniyar sarrafa bayanai tare da masu sarrafa ɓangare na uku.
explanations.hasBreachProcess: Sashe na 40 yana buƙatar bayar da rahoton ɓoyewar bayanai cikin awa 72 ga NDPC.
explanations.registeredWithNDPC: Sashe na 44 yana buƙatar rajista a matsayin mai sarrafa bayanai mai mahimmanci.
explanations.usesAI: GAID 2025 Mataki na 15 yana buƙatar bayyana gaskiya don tsarin yanke shawara ta atomatik.

cbnExplanations.collectsData: Dokokin CBN AML suna buƙatar binciken abokin ciniki don duk ayyukan kuɗi.
cbnExplanations.kycVerification: Sashe na 6 yana buƙatar shaidar abokin ciniki da za a iya tantancewa.
cbnExplanations.pepScreening: Ana buƙatar ƙarin bincike mai zurfi don abokan ciniki masu haɗari.
cbnExplanations.transactionMonitoring: Sashe na 7.1 yana buƙatar tantance ma'amaloli na ainihin lokacin.
cbnExplanations.strFiling: Sashe na 8.3 yana buƙatar bayar da rahoton STR cikin awa 24.
cbnExplanations.amlTraining: Sashe na 12.1 yana buƙatar horar da ma'aikata na shekara.
cbnExplanations.recordKeeping: Sashe na 15.1 yana buƙatar adana bayanan shekaru 5.
cbnExplanations.complianceOfficer: Sashe na 19 yana buƙatar Jami'in Amincewa da aka nada.
cbnExplanations.riskAssessment: Sashe na 5.2 yana buƙatar kimanta hadarin shekara-shekara.
cbnExplanations.independentAudit: Sashe na 18.4 yana buƙatar bincike mai zaman kansa.

problem.finePart2: — ko 2% na kudaden shiga na shekara, wanda ya fi girma. Babu manufar sirri. Babu tsarin yarda. Babu binciken bayanai.
problem.solution: RegTrack na hana wannan. Cikin mintuna, ba watanni ba.

whyBuilt.title: Me Ya Sa Muka Gina Wannan don Najeriya
whyBuilt.description: An gina shi a Abuja daga masu ƙirƙira 'yan Najeriya, don ƙa'idojin Najeriya. Mun yi imani kowane mai farawa a Najeriya ya cancanci ƙaddamarwa da tabbaci — sanin cewa ayyukan bayanansu suna kare masu amfani da kasuwancinsu. RegTrack ta wanzu saboda bin ƙa'ida bai kamata ya zama shamaki ga ƙirƙira a cikin mafi girman yanayin fasaha na Afirka ba. Ana amfani da NDP Act 2023, Tsarin Aiwatar da NDPR, da GAID 2025.
